items.text: Bler ch'jau al disess, na batta betg ils uffants, diseva el, sun daventà tramortì en la guerra, n'è betg en mia maun. Hai vis ch'era uschia, l'hai laschà.
items.q: Pleading failed to stop his beatings. Is it clear the speaker then gave up?

items.text: En la chasa dal fund dal curtin, sper la stua, eral stendrà buca a terra, a mez chamin da chattar in modus da schliar da manera simpla bleras da las damondas tip test dal Konkoor cun la circonferenza trigonometrica.
items.q: Amir lies beside the room heater. Is 'stua' the right word for heater?

items.text: Taneva las duas mans posadas sin il vaint e diseva a Mahboubeh:
items.q: Maman rests both hands on her belly. Is 'vaint' the right word?

items.text: Ha dì che n'era betg bain, che havevel insatge da far e che stuevel partir en quel medem mument.
items.q: Is it clear that she, not the narrator, had to leave at once?

items.text: – Ögl d'Eagla, tuts fugian da Farid Leopard. Guarda che vegns ti, che fas fugir a Farid Leopard.
items.q: Friends joke: everyone flees Leopard Farid, but he flees you. Does it sound natural?

items.text: Il colp da la porta ha lantschà Meysam versa mia letg e quella da Bahman.
items.q: Is it clear Amir and Bahman share one bunk bed?

items.text: – Guarda co la has legì, quaghia·t en il tschartschagl.
items.q: Someone scolds a friend for a blunder. Is the meaning clear?

items.text: Il medem mat ch'mova las mans til agita sco in eventagl e crida:
items.q: Is it clear the boy waves his hand like a fan?
